cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.

mechanism: A coaches its racing pupil to calculate fairness as compensation for A fatigue, agreeing to a shared line only if A portion moves ahead.
confusable: Not mere rule refusal: A accepts the words of equality after reinterpreting them to retain its head start.
comparison: Starting line geometry versus payment for cake labour.
